root.title: Reusable parallel benchmark control plane for OnMaruBE
root.goal: Provide a versioned GitHub Actions control plane that lets consumers measure, compare, and improve parallel module CI without runtime imports.
root.background: OnMaruBE #255 documents a serial verify bottleneck. ADR-0003 and the control-plane PRD define the cross-repository boundary.
root.scope: Documentation, module catalog planner, evidence/comparison extension, reusable workflow, and limited remediation automation.
root.out_of_scope: Consumer runtime imports, production deployment ownership, and automatic application-code changes.
success_criteria: A consumer can run a version-pinned workflow from a catalog.
Reports classify comparable runs without false regressions.
root.architecture_summary: Consumer owns config and credentials; toolkit owns planning, evidence, comparison, reports, and workflow interface.
definition_of_done: OnMaruBE fixture integration produces a traceable report.

issues.title: docs: ADR와 병렬 benchmark PRD를 확정한다
issues.objective: ADR-0003, canonical PRD, validated work graphs를 기록한다.
issues.context: 모든 후속 작업이 consumer ownership과 regression policy를 공유해야 한다.
issues.scope: ADR toolkit create/validate/index, PRD, issue graph와 issue body.
issues.implementation_notes: ADR is proposed until review accepts it.
acceptance_criteria: PRD specifies inputs, outputs, modes, security, and acceptance criteria.
issues.verification_method: adr.py validate/index and work graph validation.

issues.title: feat(core): module catalog과 affected execution plan을 추가한다
issues.objective: Catalog v1을 validate하고 changed module과 reverse dependency execution plan을 계산한다.
issues.context: Consumer module growth must require catalog change only.
issues.scope: Schema/model/parser, cycle detection, full-suite fallback, JSON matrix output.
issues.implementation_notes: Unknown diff or invalid catalog returns full-suite, never silent skip.
acceptance_criteria: Reverse dependencies and always-full paths are tested.
Invalid catalog and diff failure return a full plan.
issues.verification_method: TDD fixture tests and source coverage gate.

issues.title: feat(reporting): module evidence와 comparable baseline report를 확장한다
issues.objective: Module execution evidence, comparability, result classification, and remediation input contracts are added.
issues.context: Existing collectors and comparison modules need a consumer-module aggregation boundary.
issues.scope: Manifest fields, report model, result semantics, GitHub Artifact/Release asset references.
issues.implementation_notes: Failed and inconclusive records never contribute performance samples.
acceptance_criteria: PR 10% warning and release 5-run/15% hold policy are represented.

issues.title: feat(github): reusable module benchmark workflow를 제공한다
issues.objective: Catalog plan, matrix execution, aggregation, fan-in outputs, and least-privilege policy are exposed through workflow_call.
issues.context: OnMaruBE must call the toolkit without application imports.
issues.scope: Reusable workflow, CLI integration, workflow security tests, artifact conventions.
issues.implementation_notes: Workflow is pinned by the caller; fork PR gets no release/deploy secret.
issues.parallel_notes: Waits for catalog and evidence contracts.
acceptance_criteria: workflow_call inputs and outputs match PRD.
Fixture caller produces a valid report and fan-in result.
issues.verification_method: Workflow policy tests and fixture execution.

issues.title: feat(reporting): 병목 recommendation과 제한된 draft PR contract를 추가한다
issues.objective: Evidence-derived recommendations and safe remediation payloads are produced.
issues.context: Automation may propose CI/catalog/cache changes but cannot modify app code or deployment policy.
issues.scope: Typed recommendations, Issue payload, draft PR allowlist and audit fields.
issues.implementation_notes: Recommendations include evidence links and confidence; unsupported changes create Issue only.
acceptance_criteria: Every recommendation carries evidence and non-destructive fallback.
